Album.title: Album
Album.description: Represents an event folder or album grouping portfolio photos.

description.description: Detailed description of the event setup

coverUrl.description: URL link to the cover photo, can be a local upload URL or Unsplash URL

tag.description: Descriptive short badge tag for category grouping

date.description: The date when the event occurred

PortfolioPhoto.title: PortfolioPhoto
PortfolioPhoto.description: A specific high-resolution, watermark-scanned photograph showcasing event features.

url.description: The public URL where the image file is hosted

title.description: Friendly descriptive caption or title of the photo

category.description: The category filter group of this asset

albumId.description: Optional album identifier which this photo belongs to

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp representing the creation moment

albums.description: Contains metadata for all event specialty project folders.

photos.description: Hosts the detailed catalog of individual event images and technical feature designs.
